blogPosts.subject: Why I do not use AI
blogPosts.body:
- Makes you dumber
- Weakens skills
- Prevents learning
- Takes Away Accomplishment
- Sucks enjoyment out of coding
- Only humans make art
- AI steals other people’s work
- Struggle strengthens learning
- I do not want to sacrifice long term goals for short term gains
- Introduces bugs
- Slopy code
- lies
- does not love
- could destroy the world
- Raises computer prices
- Raises utility prices
- Bad for environment
- No returns on investment
- Turns free activities into costly subscriptions
- Creates consumer dependency
- Is anti-computer science
- Places faith in unreliable objects
- Does not benefit people
- Destroys relationships
- Fools those who lack knowledge
- Confuses those who have knowledge
- Promotes self-harm
